# Open questions generated by findings

The ordered list lives at the end of
[`EXPERIMENTS.md`](EXPERIMENTS.md) ("Open problems"), where it has been maintained
continuously since hour 1 with strikethrough as items close. It is kept there rather than copied
here so there is exactly one list and no chance of the two disagreeing.

This file exists so the project's `docs/` layout matches the repo's convention, and to hold
questions that are not yet ordered into that list.

## Not yet ordered

- Whether the core's §1A reproduction suite should treat a *refusal* as a passing grade in
  coverage accounting, or as a separate category. Piece 5 closed the gate by counting them as
  results; that decision is defensible and has not been revisited since.
